Description:  You swing your weapon looking to release as much kinetic force into this strike as possible, cracking the ground you’re standing on and even superheating the air via friction alone.
Make a melee Taijutsu attack, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 3d12 and forcing the target creature to make a Constitution saving throw on a hit.
On a failed save, the affected creature is pushed back 40-feet in a straight line and becomes Bruised. If you score a critical hit, on a failed save the affected creature is instead Stunned.
If you have Fury, you can spend it to treat your Chain Rank as 2, regardless of your current Chain rank.
Chain 2: On a failed save if the affected creature is turned into a short-range missile. Creatures that the target creature passes through while being pushed, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are picked up and pushed along the same trajectory as the original creature. At the end of the original creature’s movement, all picked up creatures are knocked Prone and become Dazed.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, damage by 1d12.

Description: You close your defenses as you guard your body with your weapons. You gain a +2 bonus to your AC against the triggering attack and all attacks made against you until the beginning of your next turn. [BOX]
| Binding Fury Stance – Fury / A Creature with Fury is also known as a Furious creature, a special state unique to users of Power weapons. A Furious creature emits a soft and ominous red mist from their pores. A Furious creature retains the Fury it has until the end of the following turn they gained the state. Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapons range
Duration: Instant
Components: M, W (Any Power)
Cost: 28 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain
Description: (To cast this jutsu, the target must be airborne) Fuel your weapon with sapping chakra and strike your opponent in their abdomen. Make a melee taijutsu attack against an airborne target. On hit they take your [Weapons damage] +5d8.
Chain 3: The affected creature must make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 60 feet into the air, as you leap after them, making another melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, you push them back to the ground, as they take double the fall damage they normally would and fall Prone.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: A-Rank
Casting Time: 1 reaction when a creature would be knocked back.
Range: Weapons range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Power), M
Cost: 16 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain
Description: You immediately match steps with the opponent, locking them in to a deadly waltz with you. You can move with them as they move, ending your movement within a 5-foot space that could hold you. At the end of the movement, you make a melee Taijutsu attack, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 4d8.

activities.label: Weapon Break
activities.text: Reaction to melee damage. Failure: its weapon breaks (a sealed weapon only to an equal or better bonus or seal).

activities.label: Chain 1: strike
activities.text: Chain 1: a creature whose weapon broke.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you take damage from a melee attack. Range: Self Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Power), M Cost: 5 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Clash Description: You quickly react to being hit by using your weapon to catch the attacking weapon at a vulnerable angle. The creature who triggered this reaction must make a Dexterity saving throw, having their weapon break on a failed save. If the triggering creatures’ weapon has Weapon Seals, it can only be broken by a weapon which has an equal or greater bonus to attack and/or damage rolls or an equal or greater ranked weapon enhancement seal.
Chain 1: A creature whose weapon you break, can be targeted with a melee taijutsu attack as part of this reaction, dealing you [Weapons damage] + 2d8 on a hit.
